Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 25

“Some yogins offer sacrifice to the gods, while others offer sacrifice itself as an oblation in the fire of Brahman.”

Krishna begins a survey of practices by pairing the most conventional with the most abstract. Both are named as sacrifice, and neither is dismissed in favour of the other.
